wins.text: North America Black Friday week was the largest demand week ever on NIKE Digital, with sales up double digits
Kobe became North America's largest signature franchise with demand far exceeding available supply; Sabrina 2 ranked as the NBA's second most worn sneaker this season
Sport performance fields of play grew year-over-year, with men's training up high teens, women's training up high single digits, and women's basketball up strong double digits
EMEA repositioned NIKE Digital as a premium platform with a strong double-digit decline in off-price sales and full price realization improving
Greater China 11/11 performance exceeded plan; Pegasus 41 topped women's running sales charts

risks.text: Q2 revenues declined 8% reported / 9% currency-neutral; NIKE Direct down 14%, NIKE Digital down 21%; gross margins contracted 100 bps to 43.6% due to higher markdowns and wholesale discounts
Q3 revenues guided down low double digits with gross margins expected down 300–350 bps, and Q4 headwinds expected to be even larger than Q3 across revenue, margins, and demand creation
NIKE Digital operating at roughly 50% full-price / 50% promotional mix, eroding channel profitability and disrupting the broader marketplace

Greater China revenue declined 11% with EBIT down 27% on a reported basis amid retail traffic declines, a difficult macro environment, and intensifying local and international competition requiring higher markdown activity
Inventory elevated above desired levels, especially in North America and Greater China; summer '25 order books down versus prior year as company accelerates franchise supply reduction

guidance_items.detail: Q3 revenues expected down low double digits, worse than Q2's -9% currency-neutral; Q4 headwinds expected to be even larger than Q3
Q3 gross margins expected down ~300–350 bps; Q4 gross margin headwind expected to exceed Q3's
Q3 SG&A guided slightly down year-over-year (vs. prior year including restructuring charges); demand creation investment expected to increase and lead SG&A growth over coming quarters
Q3 other income/expense including net interest income expected at $30M–$40M

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Specific timeline for when newness/innovation will reach sufficient scale to offset franchise liquidation headwinds in FY2026
Whether FY2026 revenues will also be down given the margin-before-sales reset approach
Specific margin recapture potential from supply chain and distribution efficiency improvements beyond top-line growth
